# PDFs Directory

This directory contains PDF files for publications organized by year.

## Structure

```
assets/pdfs/
├── 2024/
│   ├── paper-title-1.pdf
│   └── paper-title-2.pdf
├── 2023/
│   ├── paper-title-3.pdf
│   └── paper-title-4.pdf
└── 2022/
    └── paper-title-5.pdf
```

## Guidelines

- Store PDFs in year-based directories
- Use descriptive filenames (e.g., `paper-title-1.pdf`)
- Ensure PDFs are properly formatted and accessible
- Keep file sizes reasonable for web download
